name: Yuanta Securities Korea Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in Seoul, South Korea, in 1962, Yuanta Securities Korea Co., Ltd. delivers a broad spectrum of financial services to clients both domestically and across international markets. The firm offers diverse investment banking solutions, including initial public offerings (IPOs), mergers and acquisitions (M&A), private equity (PE) transactions, and capital raises, alongside managing stock and bond-related instruments. For retail and institutional investors, they provide specialized services covering stock and bond brokerage, various securities, trust management, wrap accounts, bancassurance, and retirement planning, complemented by robust asset management capabilities. Their equity division furnishes customized market insights, investment strategies, and a suite of financial products like MMFs, while also facilitating institutional IB deals. In the fixed income sphere, the company deals in a wide array of instruments such as national, public, bank, and corporate bonds, as well as commercial paper brokerage. Additionally, their futures operations encompass both domestic and international currency and commodity derivatives. Yuanta Securities Korea is also active in proprietary trading of stocks, bonds, and derivatives, and undertakes private equity investments. The company operates as a subsidiary of Yuanta Securities Asia Financial Services Limited.
